points.description: States at least two valid IPv6 objectives from the model answer (e.g. support billions of end-systems/larger address space, reduce routing tables, simplified header, better security, QoS/real-time support, multicasting, mobility, extensibility via extension headers, coexistence with existing protocols).
points.partial_credit: Half marks for one valid objective.

points.description: States at least four valid IPv6 objectives in total (any wording, brief is fine).
points.partial_credit: Quarter mark for three valid objectives.

rubric.notes: Full marks for four or more valid objectives from the model answer, in any wording; short phrases are enough. Give part marks for fewer than four (one or two valid objectives is about 0.25; three about 0.75). Wrong extra items do not cost marks; only count correct ones.
